DDInter985.mechanism: Central nervous system (CNS) stimulants, particularly the amphetamines, can potentiate the adrenergic response to vasopressors and other sympathomimetic agents.  Additive increases in blood pressure and heart rate may occur due to enhanced peripheral sympathetic activity.
